pretraining_assets.name: HuggingFace FineWeb-Edu
pretraining_assets.description: Highest quality 1.3T token subset of FineWeb, scored by an educational classifier trained on synthetic annotations. Essential for general reasoning and factual foundation.

pretraining_assets.name: DCLM-Baseline (DataComp-LM)
pretraining_assets.description: FastText quality-filtered crawl curated by Apple, shown to produce superior compute-optimal scaling curves.

pretraining_assets.name: The Stack v2 / StarCoder Data
pretraining_assets.description: Multi-language permissive code corpus. Ingesting 15% code dramatically improves algorithmic step-by-step reasoning in small language models.

pretraining_assets.name: OpenWebMath
pretraining_assets.description: 14B tokens of high-quality mathematical web pages extracted from Common Crawl, preserving LaTeX equations and proofs.

pretraining_assets.name: Proof-Pile-2
pretraining_assets.description: 55B tokens consisting of arXiv papers, formal proofs (Lean, Isabelle), and mathematical textbooks.

pretraining_assets.name: Project Gutenberg Literary Corpus
pretraining_assets.description: Clean, public-domain classical literature providing rich narrative flow, complex clause hierarchies, and long-range syntactic consistency.

pretraining_assets.name: Wikipedia & Wikibooks (Clean Cleaned Dump)
pretraining_assets.description: Structured encyclopedia text providing dense, neutral, high-factuality grounding.

pretraining_assets.name: Stack Exchange Clean QA
pretraining_assets.description: Questions and verified answers across computer science, physics, mathematics, and philosophy, teaching conversational explanation.

pretraining_assets.name: Synthetic Textbook Corpus (Phi/SmolLM Paradigm)
pretraining_assets.description: Didactic, textbook-style conceptual walkthroughs generated by frontier models, distilling complex subjects into clear introductory prose.

assets.name: SmolTalk
